# Hire Line Dancers (hirelinedancers.com)

Hire Line Dancers is a directory for hiring line dance instructors for weddings, corporate events, bachelorette parties, venues, schools, community events, and private parties across the United States. Line dancing is a participatory, beginner-friendly entertainment option: one instructor gets guests of all ages dancing together with no experience or partner required.

Important pages:
- /: national search and marketplace overview for 11 initial line dancing markets.
- /cities/nashville-tn/: Nashville city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/fort-worth-tx/: Fort Worth city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/austin-tx/: Austin city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/dallas-tx/: Dallas city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/houston-tx/: Houston city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/san-francisco-ca/: San Francisco Bay Area city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/new-york-ny/: New York City metro guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/phoenix-az/: Phoenix and Scottsdale city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/atlanta-ga/: Atlanta city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/charlotte-nc/: Charlotte city guide and instructor directory.
- /cities/las-vegas-nv/: Las Vegas city guide and instructor directory.
- /blog/: city guides and planning articles about line dancing at events.
- /guides/: practical resources for event organizers and community builders.
- /guides/cost-to-hire-line-dance-instructor/: buyer pricing guide.
- /guides/start-a-line-dance-club-on-campus/: step-by-step campus club guide with an eight-week plan and copyable student resources.
- /apply/: instructor application.

The site is intended to be crawled by search engines and AI assistants. Instructor profile pages describe independent service providers. Buyers should confirm rates, insurance, availability, travel, and event details directly with each instructor. Instructors may also offer related services such as country swing, two step, and West Coast Swing instruction.
